name: Simple Dashboard Customizer
author: Mustafizur Munna

sections.description:
Simple Dashboard Customizer lets you personalize the WordPress admin dashboard effortlessly. With this plugin, you can:

– Add your custom brand logo to the admin sidebar.
– Customize sidebar background color.
– Set custom background colors for clicked menu items.
– Change the text color for menu items and clicked menu items.
– Modify the background color of the dashboard’s content area.
– All settings are managed through an intuitive settings page in the WordPress admin.

Give your WordPress dashboard a unique look that matches your brand’s style.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the simple-dashboard-customizer folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Dashboard > SD Customizer to configure the settings.
sections.faq:
What image formats are supported for the custom logo?

The plugin supports common image formats like PNG, JPG, and GIF. But you should use PNG.

Is this plugin compatible with multisite?

Currently, the plugin settings work for individual sites only in a multisite network.
